purpose: Six crossed fixed-geometry S4 B9 solves that complete the 2x2 material x path matrix of every architecture: F_G = F_mat + F_path + F_int relative to the reference H on Gamma_H. Algebraically exact, reference-dependent, not a unique causal attribution.
assignment: G2-M5-X6/G1 consolidated assignment, 2026-11-23; scientific scope accepted in principle in https://github.com/mfs9697/NewMetacomp/pull/68#pullrequestreview-6017650419 (that review is not a GO)
bvp: unchanged LP1 policy v2 / A1: Cornell #1 three holes, plane stress, E_m = 3268.115 MPa, nu = 0.35, t = 12.7 mm, P = 1 N at (254, 203.2) mm, pin (25.4, 0), roller (482.6, 0); ring active E = ratio * E_m, same nu; inactive ring = matrix; holes are voids
physics: unchanged A1 chain: g2_a1_mesh_validate -> g2_material_phase_map -> g2_m4b_ring_activation(mask of the MATERIAL case) -> g2_m4b_sif_partial(mesh of the PATH case, [matrix, ratio * matrix]) with G2_TRAJECTORY_POLICY_v1 gates; blind COD, signed five-annulus EDI and 4x4 EDI
preSolveChecks: preflight g2_lp0_preflight via g2_a1_context: R2023a + PDE, exactly one MATLAB engine, clean tree, >= 5 GiB free RAM, LP1 source lock
A1 policy SHA, A1 source digest and LP1 policy SHA equal the pins above
path-case B9 mesh content SHA equals both this plan and G2_A1_POLICY_v1.json; A0 S4 baseline content SHA equals the policy
g2_a1_mesh_validate passes; crack polyline bitwise equal to the A0 S4 baseline polyline; crack arclength 41.4 mm
g2_material_phase_map passes on the path-case mesh

g2_m4b_activation_verify passes for the swapped mask and materials: independent chord half-plane owner oracle agrees element by element, phase from mask, ring and active area identities, conforming chords, material jump only on active-ring chords, q support and 15 mm tip guide owner-free, q clearance, connectivity, coincident nodes only at bank twins, materials admissible
material-case mask and ratio equal G2_A1_POLICY_v1.json cases; active element count equals the owner count of the active rings
postSolveChecks: all 16 g2_m4b_sif_partial criteria (elastic equilibrium and statics, blind COD vs EDI, contour independence, J-energy identity, 4x4 quadrature, q support inside core, matrix-only and ring-owner-free q support, whole-crack opening, K_I > 0, conditional K_II sign agreement, heterogeneous energy identity, active interface nodal force balance and annulus resultant, positive-definite stiffness, load/thickness/modulus)

swapped-material audit: phase counts equal the expected active and matrix element counts; active area equals the sum of the active ring areas; phaseDminEig(2)/phaseDminEig(1) equals the ratio; per-ring energies sum to the total strain energy; interface gating exactly on the active rings

authorization.resumption: none: g2_lp1_campaign_validate is called with no resume record, so any pre-admission memory HOLD requires a new investigator decision

resources.observedA1B9PerSolve: about 2.3 s, MATLAB about 1.85 GiB, available RAM change below 0.05 GiB
resources.executionClone: a separate clean clone with core.autocrlf=false holding the A1 outputs (outputs/g2_a1_geometry_v1, outputs/g2_lp1_matrix_paths_v1, outputs/g2_a1_fixed_path_v1)

stopRules: any HOLD (preflight, source, input, mesh quality, owner/activation, K extraction, swapped-material audit, record integrity, campaign) stops the campaign; no automatic retry and no resumption
a state folder that exists without STATE.mat is preserved and never retried (g2_lp1_admit_state)
at most six ADMIT entries per campaign; the six configuration identities are fixed; no other mesh, level, material, path, propagation step or refinement
no reuse of the revoked A0/A1 GO, run names, ledgers or campaign IDs

analysis.reference: H on Gamma_H (A1 H_B9); diagonal entries from the four A1 B9 states, never recomputed

predictions.P1: |F_mat| >= 0.9 |F_G| for each of stiff13, soft2, soft1
predictions.P2: F_path + F_int has the sign opposite to F_mat, as at S2
predictions.P3: no prediction for the signs of F_path and F_int separately

analysis.explorationReference: 2 U_m with U_m = 3.1e-5 (F_G) and U_theta = 8e-4 deg (MTS) from R1: an exploratory S2 mesh-family sensitivity scale, not a certified S4 error bound; |term| > 2 U_m means only 'larger than that scale'
analysis.informationalScales: A1 diagonal |F_G(B9) - F_G(B6)| and the per-solve COD-EDI relative difference are reported next to each term as numerical-sensitivity information; they are not thresholds
analysis.sensitivityOfDecomposition: Shapley split, alternative reference X on Gamma_X and the multiplicative form are reported as bookkeeping alternatives
